_about: Company & product readiness for UAE seller onboarding. Status vocabulary: 'available_in_project_files' (found and read), 'management_confirmed_proof_not_in_files', 'not_found_in_project_files' (NOT the same as 'company does not have it'), 'available_elsewhere_link_in_files' (a company document points to it), 'in_progress'. 'needed_for' = start (open the account) / complete (finish account + payouts) / listing (list products). Sources and check date on every row. Nothing here was submitted anywhere.
